build_MLP: build a multi-layer perceptron with configurable output sizes, activation functions, and optional dropout
build_ResNet: build a ResNet model with configurable blocks per group, channels, and v1 or v2 architecture
build_MobileNetV1: build a MobileNetV1 model with configurable strides, channels, and batch normalization for image classification
build_VectorQuantizer: build a VQ-VAE vector quantizer layer with configurable embedding dimension and number of embeddings
build_VectorQuantizerEMA: build a VQ-VAE vector quantizer with exponential moving average updates for embedding maintenance
